elements.reason: The process for selecting which results to collect is described: core behaviour data were extracted only when Global Score and subscale data were unavailable.

elements.quote: A standardised data extraction form was developed and piloted on a small number of studies to ensure consistency across studies and between reviewers. Extracted data items are displayed in Additional file 5. Additionally, funding sources and conflicts of interest were reviewed.
elements.reason: The manuscript states that extracted data items are displayed in Additional file 5 and mentions funding sources and conflicts of interest, but the variables are not listed and defined in the main text itself; definitions rely on a supplementary file not provided in the evidence.

elements.quote: Corresponding study authors were contacted if WLCG mean values or SDs of the EDE-Q Global Score or subscales for the two mandatory time points were missing... Post-waiting means were derived by adding the reported mean difference (MD) to the pre-waiting mean. As proposed by Morris [105] and Morris and DeShon [106], SDs in pre- and post-test populations can be assumed equal. However, to increase the precision we approximated post-waiting SDs by multiplying the pre-waiting SD by the average proportional change in SDs from pre to post observed in the remaining included studies.
elements.reason: The manuscript explicitly describes assumptions and handling of missing or unclear study information, including contacting authors, deriving post-waiting means, and imputing SDs using the Morris approach.

elements.quote: Finally, the PROM set was aligned with the recommendations of the ICHOM to ensure an international perspective and involvement of persons with lived experience.
elements.reason: The manuscript cites the ICHOM standard as the tool used to determine which outcome data items (PROM set) to collect.

elements.quote: Effects of waiting time were analysed using Hedges' g to correct for small sample sizes [119]

elements.quote: Due to the expected clinical and methodological diversity across studies, initially no meta-analysis of effect estimates was planned.
